content.introduction: Tom Lee, chairman of Bitmine Immersion Technologies, has warned of a selloff in Ethereum as South Korea's stock market crash reverberates around the world. He pointed to the country's high participation in crypto and warned that brokerage margin liquidations could create additional selling pressure on ETH and other digital assets. However, Lee stressed that the impacts on ETH are likely to be "short-term pain." Bitmine, where Lee has a vested interest, owns nearly 5% of ETH's circulating supply, a stake worth more than $15 billion U.S.
